title: Maybank and Etiqa complete tokenized bond settlement pilot using bank deposits
why_it_matters: The transaction demonstrates how a bank can coordinate digital securities and deposit-based payment within its own controlled infrastructure. Because the counterparty was Maybank's insurance arm, it does not yet establish cross-bank interoperability or a commercially available market.
caption:
RWA WIRE // NEWS

Maybank and Etiqa complete tokenized bond settlement pilot using bank deposits

Maybank tested delivery-versus-payment settlement of tokenized bonds against tokenized deposits with its insurance arm Etiqa, using SettleMint technology on a permissioned blockchain.
